newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic says tests' shelf life extended.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic says tests' shelf life extended.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said Monday it has upgraded the shelf life of its rapid HIV tests to 18 months, increasing by six months the length of time from date of manufacture that the tests can be stored at room temperature.
Shelf life for Stat Simple pylori, a rapid blood test to detect antibodies for the bacteria linked to peptic ulcers, has also been upgradeda to six months at similar temperatures.
Saliva Diagnostic said extending the shelf life of the tests enhances its competitiveness in the marketplace.

"Having a longer shelf life makes it possible for our products to be ordered in larger quantities, since customers can expect the tests to perform even if they sit in customs or are in transit for extended periods," said president and chief executive officer Kenneth McLachlan in a news release.
Saliva Diagnostic develops and makes rapid tests for infectious diseases and certain other conditions.
Shares of Saliva Diagnostic were trading unchanged at 3/4.
